findings.problem: The GitHub part is answered only by a run of the release commit ("RELEASE-FINALIZER reads it after check.yml; a temporary branch run is allowed"). The temporary-branch run is only "allowed", and PROGRESS.md lists a standing word for temporary ci/* branches as an open owner question (decisions/0106 used the owner word for it). Precedent REQ-030 had a separate later RELEASE-VALIDATOR step for its GitHub criteria.

findings.where: criteria 6 and 3 with REQ-105 criteria 1 and 7 (the favicon).
findings.problem: The kit fails a "declared expectation that never happened". I measured with a real headless Chrome: the `/favicon.ico` 404 line appears on the first load of a browser profile only; the next loads in the same profile do not repeat it. A matrix of 18 combinations or five bad addresses in one browser with a declared favicon line per page would fail by a fact of Chrome, not of the page (AP-117). The criteria are satisfiable (one browser per test, or one declaration per test), but the text does not say which.
findings.needed: Say whether a declaration is per test and "at least once", or the browser is new for each combination.
